verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is MIT-licensed and self-hostable with 'full data ownership' (hoppscotch-docs-11, hoppscotch-docs-14), and supports import/export-style features like cURL import and OpenAPI collection import (hoppscotch-gh-1, hoppscotch-docs-15), suggesting portable open-format data. However there is no explicit documentation of a full data-export feature (e.g., exporting all collections/environments/teams in one open format) and a community issue notes lack of git-friendly storage sync, undercutting full data portability claims (hoppscotch-comm-9). missing for 10: explicit full-data-export documentation, confirmation of export format (JSON/OpenAPI) for all entities, and evidence addressing the git-sync/portability gap raised by users.
